question: For ZrO2-coated lithium-ion cathode material, which ZrO2 loading gives the lowest heat generation, and how much?
rendered:
Document 1: "Valuation of Surface Coatings in High-Energy Density Lithium-ion Battery Cathode Materials"

Table 3: Onset temperature and heat generation for bare and ZrO2 coated Li1.2 Ni0.16Mn0.56Co0.08 O2 (NMC) materials.

| Sample | Onset temperature (°C) | Heat generation (J/g) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0.0 wt.% ZrO2 | 231.93 | 666.42 |
| 1.0 wt.% ZrO2 | 237.59 | 487.31 |
| 1.5 wt.% ZrO2 | 245.31 | 446.25 |
| 2.0 wt.% ZrO2 | 251.97 | 688.96 |

The 1.5 wt.% ZrO2 loading gives the lowest heat generation of 446.25 J/g.
